name: Antonio Brivio
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, oval face, neat features, slim athletic build, aristocratic composed expression
bio: Marchese Antonio Brivio Sforza was a Scuderia Ferrari regular who won the Targa Florio in 1935 and 1936 and the Mille Miglia in 1936. He also competed for Italy in bobsleigh, and after retiring from racing became a senior figure in the FIA — a rare pre-war driver who lived to see the sport he helped build turn professional.
